name: qrencode
purpose: Generates QR code PNG/SVG/ASCII images directly from text or URLs in the terminal.
explanation: Encodes any URL or string into a scannable QR code image file or terminal ASCII preview.

parameters.description: Writes the generated QR image to `<file>` (PNG by default).
Sets module dot size in pixels (e.g., `-s 8`).
Renders the QR code directly inside the terminal using Unicode blocks.

whenToUse: When generating scannable links to repositories or projects directly from CLI scripts (Worksheet 13a).
commonMistakes: Forgetting `-o <output.png>` (without `-o`, output fails or writes binary data to stdout).
moduleTitle: C13 — Meeting New Tools, Libraries & AI Rules
platformCompatibility: macOS (`brew install qrencode`) and Linux (`sudo apt install qrencode`)
explanationOfOutput: Exits with code 0 after writing the PNG file to disk.
commonErrors: `Failed to write output file` if `-o` is omitted or parent directory does not exist
